title: Fpqc torsors under flat locally finitely presented group spaces are fppf torsors
statement: Let $B$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention], and let $G\to B$ be a group algebraic space [def-trf-algebraic-space]: multiplication, identity and inverse are morphisms over $B$ satisfying the group axioms on every $B$-scheme. Assume $G\to B$ is flat and locally of finite presentation on etale scheme charts [def-weil-flat-morphism] [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. Let $X$ be an fpqc sheaf of sets on $B$-schemes [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering], with a left $G$-action, and suppose there is an fpqc covering $\{B_i\to B\}_{i\in I}$ and equivariant isomorphisms $X_{B_i}\simeq G_{B_i}$ for left translation. Then $X$ is represented by an algebraic space over $B$, and $X\to B$ is flat, locally of finite presentation and surjective. Moreover there is an fppf covering $\{U_j\to B\}_{j\in J}$ [def-pc-fppf-site] on which $X$ has sections, equivalently equivariant isomorphisms $X_{U_j}\simeq G_{U_j}$. These assertions hold after arbitrary scheme base change on $B$. No smoothness, affineness, commutativity, separatedness or quasi-compactness hypothesis on $G$ is imposed.

source.place: Cesnavicius, Problems about torsors over regular rings, arXiv:2201.06424v4, section 1.2.3, printed pp.4-5: the paragraph beginning When G is flat and locally of finite presentation states that fpqc torsors already trivialize fppf locally. The earlier paragraph gives algebraic-space representability of fppf torsors via Stacks bootstrap.tex Tag 04SK. Only this subsection is used, with no SGA input. Read online; local copy WANTED.
